name: aWATTar API
tagline: German/Austrian day-ahead hourly electricity prices for dynamic-tariff automation
description: aWATTar provides day-ahead hourly electricity market prices for Germany and Austria via a public REST API. Developers use it to fetch spot prices for dynamic-tariff automation, home energy management, and EV charging optimization.

auth.details: Public market-data endpoints require no authentication. No API key signup for basic price data.

use_cases: get current day-ahead hourly electricity prices for Germany
fetch historical aWATTar market prices for a time range
automate dynamic electricity tariff decisions for home energy systems
optimize EV charging based on cheapest hours
